# perceptual-image-dedupe

> Find duplicate and near-duplicate images with average, difference and DCT perceptual hashes, bounded PNM and PNG decoding, Hamming distance and deterministic groups. Python package `trysac-perceptual-image-dedupe`, import name `perceptual_image_dedupe`, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, out-of-scope and effort table
